title: 第4课 · 这个工作是他帮我介绍的
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 4 — 这个工作是他帮我介绍的 · He recommended me for this job

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.zh: A：生日快乐！这是送给你的！
items.py: A: Shēngrì kuàilè! Zhè shì sòng gěi nǐ de!
items.en: A: Happy birthday! This is for you.

items.py: B: Shì shénme? Shì yì běn shū ma?
items.en: B: What is it? Is it a book?

items.py: A: Duì, zhè běn shū shì wǒ xiě de.
items.en: A: Yes. It's a book I wrote.

items.py: B: Tài xièxie nǐ le!
items.en: B: Thank you so much!

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Zǎoshang yǒu nǐ yí ge diànhuà.
items.en: A: Someone called you this morning.

items.py: B: Diànhuà shì shéi dǎ de?
items.en: B: Who called?

items.py: A: Bù zhīdào, shì érzi jiē de.
items.en: A: I don't know. Our son answered it.

items.py: B: Hǎo, wǎnshang wǒ wèn yíxià érzi.
items.en: B: OK, I'll ask him this evening.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在运动场 — On the playground

items.py: A: Nǐ xǐhuan tī zúqiú ma?
items.en: A: Do you like playing football?

items.py: B: Fēicháng xǐhuan.
items.en: B: Very much.

items.zh: A：你是什么时候开始踢足球的？
items.py: A: Nǐ shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú de?
items.en: A: When did you start playing football?

items.zh: B：我十一岁的时候开始踢足球，已经踢了十年了。
items.py: B: Wǒ shíyī suì de shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú, yǐjīng tīle shí nián le.
items.en: B: I started when I was 11. I've been playing for ten years now.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在公司 — In the company

items.zh: A：你在这儿工作多长时间了？
items.py: A: Nǐ zài zhèr gōngzuò duō cháng shíjiān le?
items.en: A: How long have you been working here?

items.zh: B：已经两年多了，我是2011年来的。
items.py: B: Yǐjīng liǎng nián duō le, wǒ shì èr líng yī yī nián lái de.
items.en: B: More than two years now. I came in 2011.

items.py: A: Nǐ rènshi Xiè xiānsheng ma?
items.en: A: Do you know Mr Xie?

items.zh: B：认识，我们是大学同学，这个工作是他帮我介绍的。
items.py: B: Rènshi, wǒmen shì dàxué tóngxué, zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.
items.en: B: Yes, we were classmates at university. He recommended me for this job.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (“是……的” who did it)

items.py: Zhè běn shū shì wǒ mǎi de.
items.en: I'm the one who bought this book.

items.py: Wǎnfàn shì māma zuò de.
items.en: Mum made dinner.

items.py: Diànhuà shì shéi dǎ de?
items.en: Who made the call?

items.zh: 这个汉字不是大卫写的。
items.py: Zhège Hànzì bú shì Dàwèi xiě de.
items.en: David didn't write this character.

items.py: Diànhuà bú shì wǒ jiē de.
items.en: I wasn't the one who answered the phone.

items.zh: 今天早上八点的时候我没在家。
items.py: Jīntiān zǎoshang bā diǎn de shíhou wǒ méi zài jiā.
items.en: At eight this morning I wasn't home.

items.zh: 我十八岁的时候一个人来到北京。
items.py: Wǒ shíbā suì de shíhou yí ge rén láidào Běijīng.
items.en: When I was 18 I came to Beijing on my own.

items.zh: 我睡觉的时候，我妈妈在做饭。
items.py: Wǒ shuì jiào de shíhou, wǒ māma zài zuò fàn.
items.en: While I was sleeping, my mum was cooking.

items.zh: 麦克到学校的时候下雨了。
items.py: Màikè dào xuéxiào de shíhou xià yǔ le.
items.en: When Mike got to school it started raining.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (时间副词“已经”)

items.py: Wáng lǎoshī yǐjīng huí jiā le.
items.en: Teacher Wang has already gone home.

items.py: Wǒ de shēntǐ yǐjīng hǎo le.
items.en: I'm already better.

items.zh: 足球我已经踢了十年了。
items.py: Zúqiú wǒ yǐjīng tīle shí nián le.
items.en: I've been playing football for ten years.

items.py: Zhè běn shū shì shéi xiě de?
items.en: Who wrote this book?

items.py: Zǎoshang de diànhuà shì shéi jiē de?
items.en: Who answered the phone this morning?

items.zh: 他是什么时候开始踢足球的？
items.py: Tā shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú de?
items.en: When did he start playing football?

items.zh: 他在那儿工作多长时间了？
items.py: Tā zài nàr gōngzuò duō cháng shíjiān le?
items.en: How long has he worked there?

items.py: Gōngzuò shì shéi bāng tā jièshào de?
items.en: Who recommended him for the job?
